newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria tenders for 75,000 T optional wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria tenders for 75,000 T optional wheat - trade.

text.p: Algeria launched a tender to import 75,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat, European grain traders said on Monday.
Algeria launched the tender late on Sunday and exporters must submit their offers on Monday, traders said.
Algeria is seeking to import 50,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between February 25 and March 10 and another 25,000 tonnes for shipment in the first half of March, they said.
Last month Algeria passed on offers in a tender it had launched for the purchase of 100,000 tonnes of milling wheat.
Algeria was seeking French, Argentine or U.S. milling wheat, or any combination of the three, for shipment in February and March.
